list.title: Tournaments
list.emptyBody: Admins can set up a round-robin, Swiss or knockout event.
list.emptyBodyMember: When an organizer sets one up, it shows here.

pairingHint.fixed: A pair plays together all event and is ranked together.
pairingHint.rotating: New partners every round; each player is ranked alone.

create.title: New tournament
create.name: Name
create.targetHint: The usual target is {{points}}. Lower it to finish rounds on time.
create.pairHelp: Tap two players to pair them. Tap a pair to split it.
create.seedHelp: Seed 1 is the strongest pair; top seeds get any byes.
create.ghostsNeeded_one: Add {{count}} more player or empty seat to fill a table.
create.ghostsNeeded_other: Add {{count}} more players or empty seats to fill a table.

error.minutesInvalid: Round length must be 5 to 240 minutes.
error.targetInvalid: The target must be a positive number.
error.tooManyEntrants: A tournament can have at most 64 players.
error.notMultipleOfFour: Rotating partners needs a multiple of 4 players. Add an empty seat to fill the table.
error.knockoutNeedsPairs: Knockout is played in fixed pairs.

warning.roundRobinLarge: Round-robin with more than 6 pairs makes a long evening. Consider Swiss.
warning.swissSize: Swiss works best with 8 to 40 players.

detail.notFound: This tournament doesn't exist or you can't see it.
detail.timesUpHint: Tables finish the deal in progress, then the match is scored as it stands.
detail.myBye: Round {{round}}: you have a bye this round (counts as a win).
detail.noRoundsBody: Tables appear here when the organizer starts a round.
detail.draftBody: Entries are set. The organizer starts the tournament when everyone is here.
detail.noResult: No result — organizer can enter one

standings.name: Name
standings.empty: Standings appear once entrants are set.
standings.footnote: Ranked by match points (win 2, draw 1, loss 0), then point differential capped at ±1000 per match, then head-to-head, then total points scored. A bye counts as a win.

organizer.title: Organizer
organizer.startHint: Locks the entrant list. You can then draw round 1.
organizer.roundLive: Round {{n}} is being played. Start the next one when every table has finished.
organizer.invalid: These entrants can't form a round in this format.

draw.title: Round {{n}} draw
draw.subtitle: Check the tables, then start the round. Everyone gets a push with their table.

substitute.title: Substitute a player
substitute.consequence: {{to}} takes {{from}}'s place for the rest of the event, including any table still waiting for players. Results already played stay with the entry.

edit.title: Edit result
edit.subtitle: Round {{round}}, Table {{table}}
edit.consequence: Standings update for everyone and the change is logged with your reason.
edit.pointsInvalid: Enter whole numbers for both teams.

close.title: Finish or cancel
close.finishBody: Final standings are frozen. No more rounds can be started.
close.finishBlocked: Finish the live round first, or cancel the tournament.
close.cancelBody: Stops the event for everyone. Games already played stay in history. This can't be undone.

start.title: Start tournament
start.body_one: {{count}} entrant is locked in. Next you draw round 1.
start.body_other: {{count}} entrants are locked in. Next you draw round 1.
